subject: Immediate: temporary surge protection & blended overrun settlement
messages:
From: Sam Gupta <sam.gupta@opsly.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: contracts@opsly.ai
Date: Thu, 01 Mar 2028 18:12:00 -0700
Subject: Urgent: Campaign spike — need temporary throughput boost and billing path

Hi Evelyn,

Quick note — we flipped a new personalization campaign this morning and are already seeing a 6x token increase vs forecast. Our infra team says this could run for ~36-48 hours.

Contract ID: OPS-4481. Under the current committed tier we will exceed the monthly quota and are worried about throttles during the peak. Can Redwood provision a short-term uplift or burst pool for the next 48 hours? Also need a clear billing/true-up path so our finance team can accept the overrun.

Key asks:
- Immediate temporary throughput increase (no more than 2x current QPS).
- A predictable blended overrun rate or capped exposure for Opsly.
- Any short-form SOW or DocuSign we can sign quickly to authorize the uplift.

Appreciate a fast turnaround — campaign runs overnight across PST/EST.

— Sam
Product Ops, Opsly
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Gupta <sam.gupta@opsly.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Mar 2028 19:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: Campaign spike — need temporary throughput boost and billing path

Hi Sam — thanks for the heads-up and context. Sorry about the runway stress; we can support a short mitigation path. Options below (quick summary) — please confirm which you prefer by EOD and we’ll execute: 

Option A — Emergency uplift (recommended for immediate mitigation)
- 48-hour temporary uplift to your committed QPS (capacity carved from our burst pool).
- Blended overrun rate = 1.45x your list rate for tokens above committed during uplift window.
- We’ll auto-stop uplift at 48 hours unless you request extension.
- No upfront charge; overrun invoiced on next cycle.

Option B — Escrowed prepay (preferred if you want a fixed cost)
- Estimate extra tokens for 48 hours; Opsly prepays via an escrow invoice.
- 10% prepay discount on the estimated overrun. Any unused funds credited back.

Option C — Short-term trial credit + true-up
- We can provide the first 12 hours as a mitigation credit (no charge) and then switch to a blended overrun at 1.6x for the remainder.

Attachments: burst_pricing_grid.csv (pricing ladder + examples), opsly_uplift_sow.docx (one-page SOW / approvals template).

Ben / Marissa — tagging you for finance/contract approval. I recommend Option A to contain the incident quickly; if Opsly wants a capped exposure go with Option B.

Sam — if you confirm Option A I’ll route the uplift and notify infra to provision immediately. For Option B we’ll need a PO or e-sign.

Thanks,
Evelyn
Director, Commercial Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Mar 2028 19:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: Campaign spike — need temporary throughput boost and billing path

Eve — fine with Option A as an emergency measure. Approvals below:
- Approve 48-hour uplift immediately.
- Authorize blended overrun at up to 1.5x list rate for this event (commercial discretion). If Opsly pushes for a lower multiplier, we can agree to 1.4x provided they sign the one-page SOW and accept a post-event true-up.
- Finance will issue a short proforma invoice if Opsly requests escrow prepay.

Note: Please capture the uplift start/stop timestamps for accurate metering and include the event in the March true-up pack.

— Ben
Head of Revenue Operations
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Gupta <sam.gupta@opsly.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, contracts@opsly.ai
Date: Fri, 02 Mar 2028 08:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Immediate: temporary surge protection & blended overrun settlement

Sam — thanks. Per Ben’s sign-off we’ll proceed with the emergency uplift under these terms (please acknowledge):

Confirmed plan (Eve -> Opsly):
- Start: Fri 02 Mar 2028 08:15 PST. Duration: 48 hours (auto-stop 04 Mar 2028 08:15 PST).
- Provision: temporary uplift up to 2x current QPS drawn from Redwood burst pool.
- Billing: blended overrun rate = 1.45x list rate for tokens above committed during the uplift window.
- Metering: Redwood will capture uplift start/stop timestamps and token usage; invoices consolidated in the March billing cycle and marked as "Opsly surge true-up (OPS-4481)".
- Escrow/prepay: if Opsly wants escrowed prepay instead, reply with PO by EOD and we will send a proforma.
- Signatures: Please sign the one-page SOW (opsly_uplift_sow.docx) or reply with PO/DocuSign link.

Attachments: attached SOW + pricing grid for transparency. DocuSign link: https://redwood.app/docusign/OPS-4481-uplift

If you confirm now I’ll alert infra to provision immediately and send the metering checklist to your engineering contact.

Evelyn
Director, Commercial Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Sam Gupta <sam.gupta@opsly.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: contracts@opsly.ai
Date: Sat, 03 Mar 2028 09:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Immediate: temporary surge protection & blended overrun settlement

Evelyn — confirmed. We accept Option A under the terms you outlined (1.45x blended overrun, 48-hour uplift). Signed the SOW via the DocuSign link and copied contracting.

Please send metering checklist and notify our infra lead (cc: infra@opsly.ai) when uplift is live. Appreciate the quick help.

— Sam
